relationships.subject: SU 3327
relationships.evidence_quote: the JNK inhibitor SU 3327 was found to produce sex- and dose-dependent effects through in vivo assessment of pain

key_findings: JNK inhibitor SU 3327 is antinociceptive in the formalin test: CB2-dependent in females, CB1/CB2-dependent in males at low doses
Spinal CB2 up, beta-arrestin 1, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6 mRNA down in females only at high doses; TRPV1 unchanged
